title: Basic wine rack
text:
Basic wine rack. I like to drink the occasional bottle of wine. We have a specialty beer and wine shop down the street from our apartment so we have been known to stock up on wine from time to time. I attempted to place the bottles we had on hand in this wine rack and it proved to be rather difficult. It takes up a lot of counter space (this may just be me being picky!)
My husband made a good point that this particular wine rack did not tilt the wine bottles like other wine racks we had seen. We aren't wine experts, but this seemed like something to note. Although the price seems reasonable, this wine rack is nothing special - a basic wine rack for those who like to dabble in wine from time to time.
